title: pi-codegraph config
description: Global <agent-dir>/extensions/codegraph.json, overridden per key by <project-root>/.pi/extensions/codegraph.json. Non-boolean values are ignored.

$schema.description: Editor JSON Schema reference; not a runtime setting.

autoInit.description: Build a CodeGraph index in the background when none is found walking up from cwd (UI modes only; never in the home dir or a filesystem root).

syncOnSettle.description: Sync the index after each completed agent turn. Existing indexes still sync once at startup regardless.
